item.title: The Adobe Theater Presents John Steinbeck’s Classic Play OF MICE AND MEN Opening April 10 – May 3
item.description: ADOBE THEATER News: The Adobe Theater presents John Steinbeck’s award-winning play OF MICE AND MEN. item.description: 100MWC News: 100 Men Who Care – Los Alamos, a group of men dedicated to providing immediate and meaningful financial support to local organizations, will be holding its next quarterly event 5:30-7 p.m., Thursday, March 12, at the SALA Event Center. item.title: Power Restored To Downtown Los Alamos
item.description: COUNTY News: Power for all customers has been restored following an outage early this afternoon affecting the downtown area and east toward the Pajarito Cliffs Site. The outage occurred unexpectedly during routine work in a substation. Electric linemen from the Los Alamos Department of Public Utilities restored service within about 20 minutes. Read More The post Power Restored To Downtown Los Alamos appeared first on Los Alamos Daily Post.
